title: Employees
description: Everyone on the school's staff, active and inactive.

list.label: Employees
list.emptyBody: Add the first employee to start building the staff list.
list.noResultsBody: Try another search, or clear the filters to see everyone.

placeholders.address: 12 El Nasr Street, Nasr City, Cairo

hints.phone: Mobile, landline or international. Digits, spaces, +, - and brackets.
hints.contract: Defaults to 1 June – 31 May. Changing the start moves the end to one year later.
hints.usesBus: Turn on if the employee rides the school bus.
hints.hiddenItem: Hidden from new choices; kept for this employee.

noDepartments: No departments yet. Add them in Settings.
noStages: No stages yet. Add them in Settings.
noJobTitles: No job titles yet. Add them in Settings.

errors.nationalId: The national ID must be exactly 14 digits.
errors.phone: Enter a phone number of 7 to 20 characters, like 01012345678 or +20 2 2345 6789.
errors.email: Enter a valid email, like name@example.com.
errors.hireDateFuture: The hire date can't be in the future.
errors.salaryPositive: The salary must be more than 0.
errors.contractOrder: The contract end must be after its start.

create.title: Add employee
create.description: The employee code is assigned automatically when you save.

status.deactivateBody: Their record and history are kept. They won't be included in new payroll runs and can't get new penalties or lateness entries.
status.reactivateBody: They will be included in new payroll runs again and can get penalties and lateness entries.
